publicTitle: Module 10: How to Use the App
cardSummary: A verified beginner guide to the authenticated TradeQuip app using exact current user-facing labels and screenshot placeholders.

disclosures.title: Product Guide Notice
disclosures.body: This public guide explains the current authenticated TradeQuip product using verified user-facing labels. It is instructional documentation, not a trading recommendation, and app labels or flows may change over time.

disclosures.title: Screenshots Pending
disclosures.body: This lesson is intentionally publishing with screenshot placeholders until current captures are collected and verified against the live trader-facing app.

lessons.title: 10.1 Dashboard Navigation, Header, and Layout
lessons.summary: A beginner can feel lost if a trading app looks like many different tools at once.

lessons.title: 10.2 Account, Mailbox, Metrics, and Trade History
lessons.summary: Beginners often open the account area and see many numbers without knowing which ones describe the present, which ones describe the past, and which ones are warnings.

lessons.title: 10.3 Trading on the Trade Screen
lessons.summary: The trade screen is where beginners can make the most expensive platform mistakes.

lessons.title: 10.4 Journal, Profile Settings, Talent, and Supporting Workflows
lessons.summary: Trading is not only about clicking `Buy` or `Sell`.
